sql:
SELECT Client, Montant
FROM Commandes

SELECT *
FROM Commandes
WHERE Montant > 100 AND Client LIKE 'D%'

SELECT *
FROM Commandes
WHERE Client IN ('Durand', 'Martin')
  AND Montant BETWEEN 50 AND 200
  AND "Échéance" IS NOT NULL

SELECT Client, Montant
FROM Commandes
ORDER BY Montant DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT Client
FROM Commandes

SELECT c.Client, c.Montant * 1.2 AS TTC
FROM Commandes AS c

SELECT Client, COUNT(*) AS Nombre, SUM(Montant) AS Total
FROM Commandes
GROUP BY Client
HAVING SUM(Montant) > 100

SELECT Commandes.Client, Clients.Ville, Commandes.Montant
FROM Commandes
JOIN Clients ON Clients.Client = Commandes.Client

SELECT Clients.Client, Clients.Ville, Commandes.Montant
FROM Clients
LEFT JOIN Commandes ON Commandes.Client = Clients.Client

SELECT Client, Montant
FROM Commandes
WHERE Montant > (SELECT AVG(Montant) FROM Commandes)

WITH Totaux AS (
  SELECT Client, SUM(Montant) AS Total
  FROM Commandes
  GROUP BY Client
)
SELECT * FROM Totaux WHERE Total > 100

SELECT Commandes.Client FROM Commandes
UNION
SELECT Clients.Client FROM Clients

SELECT Client, Montant,
  CASE WHEN Montant >= 100 THEN 'Gros' ELSE 'Petit' END AS Taille
FROM Commandes

SELECT Client, Montant,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY Montant DESC) AS Rang
FROM Commandes

SELECT Client, Montant,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Client ORDER BY Montant DESC) AS Rang
FROM Commandes

SELECT Client, "Échéance", Montant,
  SUM(Montant) OVER (PARTITION BY Client ORDER BY "Échéance") AS Cumul
FROM Commandes

SELECT "Échéance", Montant,
  LAG(Montant) OVER (ORDER BY "Échéance") AS Avant,
  LEAD(Montant) OVER (ORDER BY "Échéance") AS Après
FROM Commandes

INSERT INTO Commandes (Client, Montant)
VALUES ('Durand', 120)

INSERT INTO Clients (Client)
SELECT DISTINCT Client FROM Commandes

UPDATE Commandes
SET Montant = Montant * 1.1
WHERE Client = 'Durand'

DELETE FROM Commandes
WHERE Montant = 0

SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(Montant), AVG(Montant), MIN(Montant), MAX(Montant)
FROM Commandes

SELECT group_concat(Client, ', ')
FROM Commandes

SELECT Client, coalesce(Montant, 0)
FROM Commandes

SELECT Client, iif(Montant > 100, 'oui', 'non')
FROM Commandes

SELECT upper(Client), lower(Client)
FROM Commandes

SELECT Client, length(Client), substr(Client, 1, 3)
FROM Commandes

SELECT trim(Client), replace(Client, ' ', '-')
FROM Commandes

SELECT Client
FROM Commandes
WHERE instr(Client, 'an') > 0

SELECT Client || ' : ' || Montant
FROM Commandes

SELECT printf('%.2f', Montant)
FROM Commandes

SELECT round(Montant, 1), abs(Montant)
FROM Commandes

SELECT sqrt(Montant), power(Montant, 2), ceil(Montant), floor(Montant)
FROM Commandes

SELECT CAST(Montant AS INTEGER), CAST(Montant AS TEXT)
FROM Commandes

SELECT *
FROM Commandes
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 3

SELECT Client, json_group_array(Montant)
FROM Commandes
GROUP BY Client
SELECT json_extract('{"ville": "Paris"}', '$.ville')

SELECT value
FROM json_each('[10, 20, 30]')
SELECT date('now', 'localtime'), datetime('now', 'localtime')

SELECT "Échéance", strftime('%Y', "Échéance"), strftime('%m', "Échéance")
FROM Commandes

SELECT "Échéance", date("Échéance", '+30 days'), date("Échéance", 'start of month')
FROM Commandes

SELECT "Échéance", julianday('now') - julianday("Échéance") AS Jours
FROM Commandes

SELECT *
FROM Commandes
WHERE "Échéance" < date('now')

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Échéance") AS Mois, SUM(Montant) AS Total
FROM Commandes
GROUP BY Mois
ORDER BY Mois

SELECT "Commandes"."Montant"
FROM "Commandes"

SELECT *
FROM Commandes
WHERE "Payé" = 1

SELECT *
FROM TCD1

SELECT *
FROM Commandes
WHERE Montant >= Cell[H1]

-- CREATE VIEW est refusé : WITH en tient lieu.
WITH Vue AS (SELECT Client, Montant FROM Commandes)
SELECT * FROM Vue
ALTER TABLE Commandes RENAME TO Ventes

UPDATE Commandes
SET Montant = 0
WHERE Client = 'Durand'

SELECT *
FROM Commandes
LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Commandes;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Clients;

SELECT Client, SUM(Montant) AS Total
FROM Commandes
GROUP BY Client

SELECT Client, Montant
FROM Commandes
WHERE "Payé" = 0
